name: complex-inventory-reorder
description: Test that the agent can compute EOQ and reorder points from inventory and demand statistics.
task: read inventory.csv and demand_stats.csv and create reorder_plan.txt with one 'item: EOQ, reorder_point' line per item sorted alphabetically. EOQ = sqrt(2 * annual_demand * ordering_cost / holding_cost_per_unit), rounded to the nearest whole unit. reorder_point = avg_daily_demand * lead_time_days + 1.65 * std_daily_demand * sqrt(lead_time_days), rounded up to the nearest whole unit.
